summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a proposed $100M common stock offering, with an underwriter option for an additional $15M to cover over-allotments. The shares trade on NYSE under SOC; last sale price was $6.97 on June 29, 2026. The offering is being underwritten by J.P. Morgan. The filing is an ordinary follow-on offering to raise capital, not a special situation. There are no deal terms for an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other corporate event. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The registration statement is still subject to completion.
